scenarios.assert: every declared sample has sufficient blinded responses and required calibrated instrumental metrics
consumer liking cannot be compared as a declared blinded protocol
presentation order must be controlled by a declared randomization protocol
missing sample responses are not replaced with neutral scores
a failed protocol threshold cannot be offset by energy or yield
an instrument value without calibration reference is not qualified measured evidence
measurement uncertainty crossing a declared threshold cannot be rounded into a pass
a valid measurement wholly outside a declared physical quality limit fails
metric method, basis, unit and scale must exactly match protocol
one study-scoped respondent token cannot rate the same sample twice
presentation order cannot repeat within a respondent session
protocol changes invalidate old assessment digest
quality result remains separate and no serving permit is created
unknown safety status is not promoted by consumer liking
household personal feedback is not pooled into a public consumer panel
